packaged_documentation.Mother3Recomp-v1.0.8-windows-x64/game.to:
# MOTHER 3 (Japan, A3UJ) with the MOTHER 3 Fan Translation v1.3 (English).
# Supports both the standard English v1.3 image and the High-Quality Sound Mixing Mod.

[game]
name = "MOTHER 3"
short_name = "mother3"

[program]
name = "MOTHER 3 (Fan Translation v1.3)"
id = "A3UJ"
load_address = 0x08000000
size = 0x02000000
entry_pc = 0x08000000
speculative_literal_harvest = false
aot_scan_start = 0x08000000
aot_scan_end = 0x08140000
static_resume_all = true
codegen_shards = 64

[identity]
sha1 = "306fb8874533b0fd0796208faa8bed2db4ae77fb"
md5 = "78852690de6ef51af56883c3823ea0e1"

[recompiler]
entry_point = "0x08000000"
seeds = "symbols/imported_symbols.tsv"
boundaries = "symbols/function_boundaries.tsv"
out_dir = "generated"
strict = true

[bios]
sha1 = "300c20df6731a33952ded8c436f7f186d25d3492"
hle = false
# Players should not sit through the boot logo every launch; the recompiled
# BIOS still services every SWI and IRQ (PRINCIPLES.md: presentation choice).
skip_intro = true

[rom]
sha1 = "306fb8874533b0fd0796208faa8bed2db4ae77fb"

[save]
type = "flash512"
size = 65536
path = "saves/mother3_en_v13.sav"

[runtime]
debug_port = 19893
window_title = "Mother3Recomp"

[video]
screen = "raw"
view_width = 240
resize_view = false
sharp_filter = true
widescreen = false

[audio]
shadow = false

[[data_range]]
start = 0x08000004
end = 0x080000C0
note = "cartridge header (Nintendo logo, title, game code, checksums)"

# Startup copies the crt0 IRQ implementation from ROM into IWRAM.
# Verified byte-for-byte against live IWRAM (mGBA reference, attract + naming).
[[code_copy]]
runtime_start = 0x03002EF0
source_start = 0x080000FC
size = 0x00000800
name = "irq_handler_iwram"
note = "crt0 IRQ dispatcher relocation; matches live IWRAM for 0x800 bytes"

[[extra_func]]
addr = 0x03002EF0
mode = "arm"
name = "irq_handler_iwram_entry"

[[extra_func]]
addr = 0x03003004
mode = "arm"
name = "irq_handler_iwram_sub"
note = "secondary ARM entry inside crt0 IRQ handler block"

# Sound driver hot path copied with CpuSet(0x0808ED81 -> 0x03000000, 0x100 words)
# by the routine at 0x0808F9A2.
# Note: When the High-Quality Sound Mixing Mod (SHA-1 4ffe71ce...) is active,
# 0x03000000 holds the 16-bit mixing workbuffer (hq_buffer) and the self-modifying
# m4a_hq_mixer lives at 0x03001C00..0x0300247C; src/main.cpp intercepts and executes
# m4a_hq_mixer natively in C++ while guarding 0x03000000 against stale AOT entry.
[[code_copy]]
runtime_start = 0x03000000
source_start = 0x0808ED80
size = 0x00000400
name = "sound_driver_iwram"
note = "CpuSet 32-bit x 0x100 from literal pool at 0x0808F9F0"

[[extra_func]]
addr = 0x03000000
mode = "thumb"
name = "sound_driver_iwram_entry"

# Sprite priority sort copied by 0x08050D64 (memcpy 0x100 bytes).
[[code_copy]]
runtime_start = 0x03005714
source_start = 0x080566C8
size = 0x00000100
name = "oam_sort_iwram"
note = "Copied by 0x08050D64; Thumb"

[[extra_func]]
addr = 0x03005714
mode = "thumb"
name = "oam_sort_iwram_entry"

# Nintendo FLASH512_V131 library helpers. The library copies these
# position-independent Thumb routines into RAM (EWRAM buffer or the active
# IWRAM stack) before calling them. src/main.cpp validates the live bytes
# against these immutable ROM templates and dispatches the AOT code here.
[[extra_func]]
addr = 0x080911D4
mode = "thumb"
name = "flash_read_byte_template"
note = "ldrb r0,[r0]; bx lr - copied by 0x080911D8"

[[extra_func]]
addr = 0x08091218
mode = "thumb"
name = "flash_copy_template"
note = "0x24-byte read loop; copied to IWRAM stack (seen at 0x03006D00/0x03006D44)"

[[extra_func]]
addr = 0x080912D8
mode = "thumb"
name = "flash_compare_template"
note = "0x30-byte verify loop; copied to IWRAM stack (seen at 0x03006C88)"

[[extra_func]]
addr = 0x0809184C
mode = "thumb"
name = "flash_verify_erased_template"
note = "0x24-byte 0xFF sector erase-verify loop; copied to IWRAM stack by 0x08091728"

# Field-engine routine copied by the code at 0x08032F7C (0x100 bytes, Thumb).
[[code_copy]]
runtime_start = 0x03004C14
source_start = 0x0803D59C
size = 0x00000100
name = "field_iwram_routine"
note = "Verified against live IWRAM after Chapter 1 field play (mGBA reference)"

[[extra_func]]
addr = 0x03004C14
mode = "thumb"
name = "field_iwram_routine_entry"

# Second field routine copied by the same code (0x08032F5C): 0x0803D5EC -> 0x03004D14.
[[code_copy]]
runtime_start = 0x03004D14
source_start = 0x0803D5EC
size = 0x00000100
name = "field_iwram_routine_2"
note = "Literal pool 0x08032F84/0x08032F88; verified in long Chapter 1 reference traces"

[[extra_func]]
addr = 0x03004D14
mode = "thumb"
name = "field_iwram_routine_2_entry"

# Widescreen: the field culls actors against the native 240x160 view through
# these two overlap tests (rect, pos, size). src/m3_widescreen.cpp answers them
# against the widened view while widescreen is on.
[[mod_function_hook]]
addr = 0x080357D0
mode = "thumb"
note = "actor box vs view rect overlap (widescreen culling)"

[[mod_function_hook]]
addr = 0x08035820
mode = "thumb"
note = "actor box vs view rect overlap, looping maps (widescreen culling)"

# Setup and controls

## Game files

Supply your own MOTHER 3 ROM. Desktop builds request a GBA BIOS; Android can use its built-in BIOS substitute. ROMs, BIOS dumps and translation patches are not included in the downloads.

- **English:** use the English fan translation v1.3 ROM, or apply its UPS patch to a clean Japanese ROM.
- **Spanish and other patches:** v1.0.4 onward accept IPS, IPS32, BPS and UPS patches through the launcher. Start with the ROM version required by the patch.
- **HQ Audio:** built in; it applies automatically to the Japanese ROM and supported fan translations after the selected language patch. Compatible ROM mods are handled when their sound layout matches.

Unknown patch outputs use the compatibility interpreter and may run more slowly. Support varies by patch.

<details>
<summary>ROM and BIOS identification</summary>

SHA-1 values:

- Japanese ROM: `4f0f493e12c2a8c61b2d809af03f7abf87a85776`
- English v1.3: `306fb8874533b0fd0796208faa8bed2db4ae77fb`
- English + HQ Audio: `4ffe71ce5c5e1e8d9be5fbd09968b60787169b21`
- Retail GBA BIOS: `300c20df6731a33952ded8c436f7f186d25d3492` (16 KiB)

</details>

## Launch

- **Windows:** extract the ZIP and open `Mother3Recomp.exe`.
- **Linux / Steam Deck:** extract the archive and open the included launcher. Ubuntu/Debian users need `libsdl2-2.0-0` and `libgl1`. Steam Deck users can add the launcher as a Non-Steam Game.
- **Android:** install the APK, open the app and select your game files. Preserve app data when updating to keep saves.

Keep the executable with its bundled libraries and assets. Back up saves before changing builds or patches.

## Launcher

The first launch asks for your BIOS and ROM in your system's file picker. Pick the English v1.3 ROM, or the
Japanese ROM and then its translation patch (the patched ROM is saved in `mods/rom-patches`). After that,
MOTHER 3's own launcher opens: the party walks around outside Tazmily while you pick **Play**, **Settings**,
**Controls** or **Mods**. Everything it shows is drawn from your ROM; no game art ships with the download.

- **Settings:** window flavor (the game's Plain to Melon), display mode, window size, scaling, screen colors,
  volume, **Button prompts**, **Frame rate**, **Import a save file**, and **Change game files** to pick a different
  ROM or BIOS.
- **Import a save file:** bring over a save from another emulator (mGBA, VBA, RetroArch, My Boy!, etc.). Pick its
  battery save (`.sav` or `.srm`, not a save state). Your current save is kept as `saves/mother3_en_v13.sav.bak`.
  On Android, use **Import a save from another emulator** on the setup screen.
- **Frame rate (smooth):** on a 100 Hz or faster screen (120, 144, 165, 240 Hz...), a frame is drawn for every
  refresh of the screen, each at its own moment between two of the game's frames, so scrolling and walking move
  in smaller steps. The launcher shows your screen's rate, such as **144 (smooth)**. The game itself still runs at
  its normal speed. On a 60 Hz screen it has no effect, and the launcher says so. If your screen is fast but the
  game still shows 60 fps, choose **Smooth (always)**, which skips the screen check.
- **Japanese (untranslated):** pick the Japanese ROM and answer **Yes** to play it in Japanese. The launcher opens as
  usual, with its own font, since the Japanese ROM has no English letters.
- **Other translations** (Spanish, Italian, Brazilian Portuguese and others) open the launcher too; when a ROM's font
  differs from English v1.3's, the launcher uses its own font. A ROM the launcher can't draw from starts the game
  directly, using the settings from the last time you used the launcher.
- **Controls:** pick a GBA button, then press the new key or controller button; whichever you press is the one
  that changes (Escape cancels). On controllers the left stick always moves; the D-pad is the rebindable second input.
- **Getting around:** each page shows its buttons at the bottom. B (or Z / Escape) goes back, and LB / RB
  (or Q / E) jumps between Settings, Controls and Mods.
- **Button prompts:** the game's own text ("press the A Button") shows the button you actually use: Xbox,
  PlayStation or Nintendo labels, or your keyboard key, switching when you change controller. Set a fixed style
  in Settings if you prefer.
- **Mods:** put `.ips`, `.bps` or `.ups` patches in the `mods` folder (the page has an **Open mods folder**
  button) and tick them. Mods that change game code are marked *slower*: they run in compatibility mode.
- **Widescreen:** Settings > Widescreen shows 16:9 in towns, fields, rooms and battles: the field draws the real
  map into the sides and battle backgrounds continue their pattern. Menus and anything else stay 4:3 with black
  sides. At the edge of a map both sides go black by the same amount, so the picture stays centred, and screen wipes stay black outside. The bezel is not used in widescreen.
- **Bezel (Windows):** built from your ROM on first launch in your window flavor; F10 hides it.

## Controls

| Action | Keyboard |
| --- | --- |
| Move | Arrow keys |
| Confirm / cancel | X / Z |
| L / R | C / V |
| Start / Select | Enter / Right Shift |
| Toggle bezel (Windows) | F10 |
| Runtime menu (desktop) | F11 |
| Exit (desktop) | Escape |

Controllers move with the left stick (the D-pad works too). Rebind keys and buttons on the launcher's Controls page.

## Known issues

- [Android device-specific performance reports](https://github.com/josiahg2502-glitch/Mother3Recomp/issues/9).
- [Desktop F11 crash reports](https://github.com/josiahg2502-glitch/Mother3Recomp/issues/8).

When reporting a problem, include the app version, device/OS, patch version, steps and any error text. Candidate fixes are under review; device performance still needs confirmation.

packaged_documentation.ninety-four-windows-x86_64/README.txt:
ninety-four v0.3.6: NHL '94, rebuilt in C
https://github.com/1nputs/ninety-four

You need your own NHL '94 ROM (the 1 MB US/Europe retail cartridge dump). Run nhl94.exe: the first
time it asks for the ROM in a file browser and remembers it (or give it: nhl94.exe --rom FILE).

Keys        Player 1     Player 2
D-pad       arrows       I J K L
A / B / C   Z / X / C    Q / W / E
Start       Enter        Tab

Game controllers work too (the first two are players 1 and 2).

F1                 mute
F2 / F3            volume down / up
F4 (held)          rewind
F5                 pause
F6 (held)          fast-forward
F7                 slow motion on / off
F8                 a frame at a time, while paused
F10                save the replay: the last 20 seconds, as a GIF (in a "videos" folder)
F11                start / stop recording a GIF
F12                screenshot (a PNG in a "screenshots" folder)
Esc                the menu (save and load states there)
Alt+Enter          full screen

The menu (Esc, or a controller's Back button) has the ROM, a reset, save slots, the video (a
pixel-art upscaler: Scale2x, Scale3x, MMPX or xBR; sharp, integer or fit scaling; square pixels or
4:3; the colors' levels; dithering blended as a television blended it; a picture tube's scanlines
and mask; full screen; vsync), captures, the sound (volume, the FM core and chip), the
players, the rosters, the game rules, online play, options and every key: pick one and press the
new key.

Game rules (the menu's Game rules page, for every player and the whole game; Classic, the default,
is the original exactly): the weight bug fixed, the second assist kept on a give-and-go, plus/minus
and body checks in Player Stats, more period lengths, the season's overtime length, skating speed,
the speed burst, shot power, how far the puck slides, tiring, bench rest, rest in the penalty box,
how many penalties are called, hot and cold streaks, a wide rink view, and presets (Classic,
Simulation, Arcade). The amounts are numbers underneath: settings.ini takes any in a rule's range
(rules.skating = 115), and so does --rule skating=115.

Rosters (the menu's Rosters page): the cartridge's teams, or rosters of your own of up to 32 teams,
with their players, ratings, lines, colors, logos, banners, center ice, photos and even the title
screens and rinks, as CSV files and PNGs in a "rosters" folder beside the program (or anywhere:
the page's Files line finds one). To start one, or take one from a community hack made on the
32-team template, or pack one into a single zip to send:

    nhl94.exe --export-rosters rosters/my-rosters
    nhl94.exe --extract-rom "HACK.bin" rosters/2026
    nhl94.exe --check-rosters rosters/my-rosters
    nhl94.exe --pack-rosters rosters/my-rosters my-rosters.zip

(each with --rom FILE, unless the ROM is beside the program as "NHL 94 (UE) [!].gen"). The page
says what the chosen rosters hold: their files, their teams and their best players and teams by the
game's own ratings. Everything about the files is in ROSTERS.md.

Four players: in the menu, Players, set Controllers to EA 4 Way Play, Reset, then choose Players:
Three or Four in the game's setup screen. The Players page also gives each player a controller,
moves a controller's buttons, adds turbo and sets the stick's dead zone.

Online play (the menu's Online play page): two to four machines, over the internet or a LAN, with
rollback, so no one waits. Set Name and Players here (how many play at this machine). One
machine hosts (Role: host, and Total players) and the others join its address and port (7000
by default; the host's port must be reachable, forwarded on its router for UDP); two machines can
instead both connect at once, which most home routers let through without a forwarded port. When
everyone is in, the game powers on everywhere: the host's players on pads 1 onward, then each
machine's as it joined; with pads 3 or 4 played, EA's 4 Way Play is in the ports (Players: Three
or Four). The host's rosters and game rules go to everyone, and every game online starts from a
new cartridge (nothing is saved to anyone's save file). Seasons and records go online in a state:
anyone's Save state saves one everyone played, and the host's Load state loads one for everyone
(a state of other rosters than the session's is refused). The host's Reset (in the menu) starts
the game again for everyone; the host can change its Rosters or Game rules first, and the new
ones go to everyone with that Reset. If anyone leaves, the game is over for
everyone. Every machine needs this same build and the US/Europe
cartridge.

Save slots: eight, each with a picture, on the menu's Save and Load pages (states are taken during
play). Quitting saves the Autosave, first on the Load page: the game always starts fresh.

Captures: the last 20 seconds are always kept; F10 (or the menu's Capture page) saves them and
F11 records until pressed again, as GIFs (exact colors, 30 frames a second, no sound). The
Capture page sets the replay's length and a GIF's size.

Everything is kept in settings.ini, beside the program in the folder you run it from, with the
saves (an "out" folder), save slots ("states"), screenshots and videos.

The licenses of the code inside are in "licenses": ninety-four (MIT), pulseman (MIT), Nuked-OPN2
(LGPL-2.1), ymfm (BSD-3), MMPX (MIT), xBR (MIT), and SDL2 (zlib). The source of everything is at
the address above and at https://github.com/1nputs/pulseman.

Windows: x86-64, Windows 10 or newer; SDL2.dll must stay beside nhl94.exe. Built with MinGW-w64 GCC.

# recvx-enhanced-port

[![build](https://github.com/aikatore/recvx-enhanced-port/actions/workflows/build.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/aikatore/recvx-enhanced-port/actions/workflows/build.yml)

A native PC port of *Resident Evil Code: Veronica X* (PS2) for Linux and Windows, built from the
community decompilation [recvx-decomp](https://github.com/AshfordFamily/recvx-decomp). The
original game code and its PS2 platform layer are compiled for the PC; the PS2 hardware
underneath (GS, VU, DMA, sound driver, disc, memory card, pad) is emulated at its boundaries, and
native paths replace the expensive parts. The game reads your own disc image in place.

[![Resident Evil Code: Veronica X (PS2) | PC recompilation with online co-op and Third-Person](https://img.youtube.com/vi/0sW1BHgIMXs/maxresdefault.jpg)](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0sW1BHgIMXs)

*Click the image to watch the video on YouTube.*

## Features

- **Enhanced renderer**: native 3D and textures on the GPU, widescreen (hor+, up to ultrawide),
  internal resolution up to 8x, in-between frames up to the display's refresh rate while the game
  logic stays at its original 30 FPS, a frame rate limit, optional PS2 motion trail.
- **Online co-op for two players**: direct, automatic or server-relayed connections, a lobby in
  the title menu, join codes and passwords, trading with item requests, shared or individual loot,
  saved partner inventories, rejoin after a crash. Includes a small C rendezvous/relay server.
- **Third-person mode** (optional): over-the-shoulder camera with mouse/keyboard controls, free
  aim and two camera styles.
- **Modern controls** (optional) for the fixed cameras: the stick walks where it points on screen,
  as in the RE HD remasters, and keeps its direction through camera cuts.
- **Model swaps**: play as other characters and creatures, with matching voices and cutscene
  doubles.
- **Enemy options**: extra enemies, rearranged placements, a seeded randomizer, and an enemy
  spawner.
- **BioRand**: randomized items, start inventories and doors from
  [BioRand](https://github.com/biorand/classic) seeds, switched on at the title, in co-op too (see
  [USER_GUIDE.md](docs/USER_GUIDE.md#randomizer-biorand)).
- **Save files**: every save its own file, as many as you like, in the game's own save screens
  without the memory card screens (the emulated memory card stays available).
- **Enhanced settings** in the game's own OPTION menu and an F1 overlay; full rebinding of keyboard,
  mouse and gamepad; per-window input source for local co-op on one PC.
- **Cheats and debug tools** (F2), co-op window (F3).
- **HD texture packs**: PCSX2 HD texture packs for the game load as they come, from
  `mods/textures/` (see [HD texture packs](#hd-texture-packs)).
- **Mods**: replacement room files and archive entries from a `mods/` folder, plus tools to build
  new rooms.
- **Tooling** for determinism checks, rendering comparisons and profiling.

## Requirements

- Your own disc image of *Resident Evil Code: Veronica X*, PS2 NTSC-U, **SLUS-20184** (`.iso`).
- **Linux**: an x86 PC; the game is a 32-bit (i686) program and needs glibc 2.34 or newer plus
  the 32-bit (multilib) OpenGL, X11/Wayland and audio libraries.
- **Windows**: Windows 10 or later (32-bit executable, runs on 64-bit Windows).
- A GPU with OpenGL 3.3.

## Download

Prebuilt Linux and Windows builds and the co-op server are on the
[Releases](https://github.com/aikatore/recvx-enhanced-port/releases) page (no game data
included). Unpack and run `recvx.exe` (Windows) or `./recvx` (Linux); see
[docs/USER_GUIDE.md](docs/USER_GUIDE.md).

## HD texture packs

HD texture packs made for the PCSX2 emulator (for SLUS-20184, the US release) work without
conversion. None are included; use a pack you have.

1. Create a `textures` folder inside the `mods` folder, which sits next to the game (beside
   `recvx.exe` / `recvx` and the `save` folder): `mods/textures/`.
2. Put the pack in there as it comes. Any of these layouts works:
   - `mods/textures/SLUS-20184/replacements/...` (the folder from PCSX2's `textures` directory)
   - `mods/textures/replacements/...`
   - `mods/textures/<pack name>/...`, or the `.dds` files themselves
3. Start the game. The log says `hd textures: N replacements in <folder>`.

**Several packs and load order:** put each pack in its own folder and number the folders, for
example `mods/textures/1_addon/` and `mods/textures/2_base/`. When two packs replace the same
texture, the one in the folder that comes first by name wins, so `1_...` overrides `2_...`.

Settings (F1 or ENHANCED SETTINGS, DISPLAY): **HD Textures** turns packs on or off, **HD
Menus** also uses redesigned menus, title and inventory (on), **HD Font** uses
the pack's font (off). A pack in another folder: `hd_textures_dir = <path>` in `recvx.ini` or
`--hd-textures <path>`. Details: [docs/USER_GUIDE.md](docs/USER_GUIDE.md#hd-texture-packs).

## Building from source

```sh
git clone --recursive https://github.com/aikatore/recvx-enhanced-port.git
cd recvx-enhanced-port
cmake -B build -G Ninja -DCMAKE_TOOLCHAIN_FILE=cmake/linux-i686.cmake -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=RelWithDebInfo
cmake --build build
./build/pc/recvx
```

`--recursive` fetches the decompilation and its header submodules; the decomp's large compiler
submodule is skipped by design (the PC build does not use it). On the first start a file
selector asks for the disc image; the choice is remembered. The Windows build is cross-compiled
with mingw-w64: see [docs/BUILDING.md](docs/BUILDING.md).

## Documentation

| Document | For |
|---|---|
| [docs/USER_GUIDE.md](docs/USER_GUIDE.md) | players: first start, settings, controls, cheats, saves, troubleshooting |
| [docs/COOP.md](docs/COOP.md) | players and developers: online and local co-op, protocol reference |
| [docs/SERVER.md](docs/SERVER.md) | running the co-op rendezvous/relay server |
| [docs/BUILDING.md](docs/BUILDING.md) | building on Linux and for Windows, CMake options, tests |
| [docs/ARCHITECTURE.md](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md) | developers: how the port works, renderer, determinism, test aids |
| [docs/THIRDPERSON.md](docs/THIRDPERSON.md) | third-person mode internals |
| [docs/ACTORS.md](docs/ACTORS.md) | models, skeletons, animation, model swaps |
| [docs/ENEMIES.md](docs/ENEMIES.md) | enemy data, spawner, enemy options |
| [docs/HD_PACK.md](docs/HD_PACK.md) | how PCSX2 HD texture packs are matched and loaded |
| [docs/modding/](docs/modding/README.md) | room format and building custom rooms |
| [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md) | feature history |
| [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) | how to contribute |

- Libraries: [SDL 3](https://github.com/libsdl-org/SDL) (zlib),

route.title: Attach normal play after upstream settings
route.instruction: In upstream setup, finish all settings and turn off the documented Show launcher at startup option. Then select south_park_tr.exe, set the complete extracted player directory as working directory and leave arguments empty. Review the intent and request Play separately, without holding Shift. With valid prepared files and that saved setting, the app continues into the linked game in process. Missing files/Shift can reopen the launcher; finish setup or restart-requiring changes outside the attached attempt. This guide uses no internal skip flag and does not promise tracking through a replacement process.

source_setup.title: Prepare the exact owned XBLA package
source_setup.instruction: Use a complete player and components you are independently permitted to use, with your own purchased full South Park: Tenorman’s Revenge Xbox Live Arcade package, title ID 58410B80. The documented default.xex is version 0.0.0.1 (2012-03-08), 3,870,720 bytes, CRC32 1F353EBD, SHA1 A0E831E4B49A08E5EE8B24BB08EE3B0231FC6E04. The selected launcher checks title ID at package selection and executable size/CRC after import; those are not cryptographic package authentication or entitlement. Container hashes differ with owner-specific headers. Other games, revisions and title updates remain unsupported.

persistence.title: Preserve the distinct data roots
persistence.instruction: Keep game/ beside the executable, south_park_tr.toml, packaged libraries/notices, logs and metadata/achievement art derived from your own package, plus the actual player save/profile root normally Documents/south_park_tr on Windows. Use the upstream About page to identify the existing root; a relocated Documents folder or configured external data/config root must also be preserved. Do not infer another South Park game’s save compatibility. This guide performs no import, migration, restore, backup or deletion.

limitations: Use this title’s exact purchased package and saved startup settings. Keep game/configuration and actual Documents save roots; settings restarts and upstream updates can replace the selected process.
rows.closure_boundary: Finite source/setup and existing non-owning registration outcome; independent review and delivery required. No Supported/native/managed-operation acceptance.

packaged_documentation.NinjaGaidenBlack/README.txt:
Ninja Gaiden Black - static recompilation for Windows (Vulkan)

The game itself is not included. Start NinjaGaidenBlack.exe and choose your own copy of
the retail USA Xbox release: a disc image (.iso, a full Redump dump, or the .7z/.zip it came in)
or a folder of extracted files with default.xbe. A disc image is installed once (about 6 GB) into
%LOCALAPPDATA%\NinjaGaidenBlack\game; saves are kept there too, settings in
%APPDATA%\NinjaGaidenBlack.

Needs Windows 10 or 11 (64-bit) and a GPU with Vulkan 1.3 drivers (or older drivers that have
its dynamic rendering and synchronization2 as extensions).
Start it from a command prompt to see its log.

# Third-party components

This project's own code is under the GNU General Public License, version 3 or (at your option) any
later version (GPL-3.0-or-later, [LICENSE](LICENSE); up to 0.9.24, GPL-2.0-or-later); the
`xboxrecomp/` directory keeps its MIT license. The project is built from, and its release packages contain, the following parts, each under
its own license.

## In this repository

| Component | Where | License |
|---|---|---|
| TGP482's [Xbox XBE Recomp SDK](https://github.com/TGP482/Xbox-XBERecomp) / [SCDA-XBERecomp](https://github.com/TGP482/SCDA-XBERecomp) renderer code | `src/d3d/gpu`, and followed by `src/d3d/hle.cpp`, `src/d3d/vk/backend.cpp` | MIT — see `src/d3d/NOTICE` |
| TGP482's [SCDA-XBERecomp](https://github.com/TGP482/SCDA-XBERecomp) DirectSound code | followed by `src/audio/dsound_hle.cpp` | MIT — see `src/audio/NOTICE` |
| EB Garamond | `assets/fonts` | SIL Open Font License 1.1 (`assets/fonts/OFL-EBGaramond.txt`) |
| Liberation Serif | `assets/fonts` | SIL Open Font License 1.1 (`assets/fonts/OFL-Liberation.txt`) |
| Xelu's Free Controller & Key Prompts | `assets/prompts/keys`, `assets/prompts/ps`, `assets/prompts/xbox` | CC0 (`assets/prompts/License-Xelu.txt`) |
| Kenney's Mobile Controls (the touch controls' sticks and d-pad) | `assets/touch` | CC0 (`assets/touch/License-Kenney.txt`) |
| SDL2's Android activity (Java) | compiled from SDL's source by `packaging/android/build.sh` | zlib |

## The runtime: xboxrecomp

[xboxrecomp](https://github.com/sp00nznet/xboxrecomp) (the recompiler and the Xbox runtime this game
runs on, in `xboxrecomp/` with this port's changes) is MIT licensed (`xboxrecomp/LICENSE`); its
`NOTICE` lists what it contains or fetches under other licenses, among them:

| Component | License |
|---|---|
| xemu's NV2A GPU model and Vulkan renderer, MCPX APU (`src/nv2a_vk`, `src/apu`) | LGPL-2.1-or-later |
| xemu's shader generators (`src/nv2a_vk/xemu/pgraph/glsl/psh.c`, `vsh-prog.c`, `vsh-prog.h`, `pgraph/vsh_regs.h`) | GPL-2.0 or GPL-3.0 |
| volk, Vulkan Memory Allocator, Vulkan-Headers | MIT / Apache-2.0 |
| SPIRV-Reflect | Apache-2.0 |
| stb (stb_truetype, stb_image) | MIT / public domain |
| xxHash | BSD-2-Clause |

## Libraries in the release packages

| Library | License | Package |
|---|---|---|
| SDL2 | zlib | all |
| GLib, libintl, libiconv | LGPL-2.1-or-later | Linux, Windows (Windows: libintl, libiconv; Android uses its own small stand-in, `xboxrecomp/src/nv2a_vk/shim/glib-lite`) |
| PCRE2 | BSD-3-Clause | Linux, Windows |
| glslang | BSD-3-Clause and others (see its LICENSE) | all |
| SPIRV-Tools | Apache-2.0 | Linux, Windows |
| LLVM libc++ (the NDK's, linked in) | Apache-2.0 with LLVM exception | Android |
| Mesa's Turnip (Vulkan driver for Adreno, built from Mesa's release) | MIT | Android |
| libadrenotools | BSD-2-Clause | Android |
| libepoxy | MIT | Linux |
| Qt 6 (the setup window) | LGPL-3.0 | Linux |
| LLVM libc++, libunwind | Apache-2.0 with LLVM exception | Windows |
| mingw-w64 winpthreads | MIT and ZPL-2.1 | Windows |

The LGPL libraries are shared libraries inside the packages and can be replaced by other builds of the
same version.

## The game

*Ninja Gaiden Black* © Koei Tecmo / Team Ninja. None of the game's data (graphics, sound, movies,
text) is in this repository, and its recompiled code is generated from the player's own copy when
building (`tools/pipeline.sh`); the game's data is installed from it on the first start. The
repository does include C translations of some of the game's functions, taken from that generated code
and modified for this port (the menus, the mouse, the cheats: `src/main_menu.c`, `src/pause_tab.c`,
`src/menu_mouse.c` and others, listed in `src/manual_functions.json`), and the Direct3D functions of
the Xbox SDK the game was built with (`src/d3d/d3d_orig.c`), behind the renderer's hooks.

route.title: Attach the main prepared player
route.instruction: Select NinjaGaidenBlack.exe, use the full extracted NinjaGaidenBlack directory as working directory and leave arguments empty. Review the exact intent and request Play separately, using the already installed data/settings. The normal main game runs through the linked Xbox-compatible runtime. Complete missing original/setup prompts outside the attached attempt. The arcade menu/cabinet and return path hand off to companion programs; their process/lifetime behavior is not qualified by this main-player attachment. Finish such transitions outside its claimed journey instead of assuming successor tracking.

source_setup.title: Prepare the supported original upstream
source_setup.instruction: Use a complete player and components you are independently permitted to use, with your own Ninja Gaiden Black Xbox USA data, title 5443000D. The selected importer identifies its exact default.xbe by 4,571,136 bytes and FNV-1a-64 3602ba6a6079c8cd; it can also accept matching section contents under a different header layout. This is structural/source compatibility, not cryptographic authentication or permission for another revision. Finish the upstream owned-disc or extracted-folder setup before attachment and keep independent originals. This guide enables no mismatch-bypass/debug override and obtains or executes no original, extractor, helper or game.

persistence.title: Preserve the separate Windows data roots
persistence.instruction: Keep installed game data, saves, log.txt and shaders under the actual data root, normally %LOCALAPPDATA%/NinjaGaidenBlack, and settings.ini/controls.ini under %APPDATA%/NinjaGaidenBlack. Preserve any established NGB_SAVE_DIR, NGB_CONFIG_DIR, NGB_GAME_DIR or other external game/config roots and original discs independently. The main game and arcade companions share their upstream layout; no cross-region, chapter, arcade or imported-save compatibility is inferred. This guide performs no install, migration, restore, backup or deletion.

limitations: Keep both Windows data/config roots and matching companions. Main-game attachment does not establish arcade handoff, real-save or physical Windows qualification.
rows.closure_boundary: Finite source/setup and existing non-owning registration outcome; independent review and delivery required. No Supported/native/managed-operation acceptance.

rows.canonical_next_action: Review official player setup and data/persistence boundaries for the specific offered route; metadata alone does not qualify execution.

packaged_documentation.SSF2THDRemix-v0.3.0-windows-x64/README.t:
Super Street Fighter II Turbo HD Remix - PC port
Version 0.3.0

Super Street Fighter II Turbo HD Remix for Xbox Live Arcade, statically
recompiled to run natively on Windows with the ReXGlue SDK. This is a native
recompilation, not an emulator.

Source code and issue tracker:
https://github.com/saulob/ssf2t-hd-remix-recompiled


NO GAME FILES ARE INCLUDED
--------------------------
You need your own copy of the game: the Super Street Fighter II Turbo HD Remix
Xbox Live Arcade package. The official Title Update #1 is optional:


  Title ID:      584108A4
  Media ID:      37B7D7D3
  Game package:  required, game version 0.0.1.3 (Xbox Live Arcade, default.xex)
  Title Update:  optional, Title Update #1, updates the game to 0.0.2.3
                 (default.xexp)

With only the game package the port plays version 0.0.1.3. Installing the
Title Update enables the updated version 0.0.2.3, and removing it returns to
0.0.1.3. The same program runs both.
Any other version is refused by the launcher, which names the version it found.


REQUIREMENTS
------------
- Windows 10 or 11, 64-bit
- A DirectX 12 capable graphics card
- The latest Microsoft Visual C++ Redistributable 2015-2022 (x64). Most PCs
  have it. If Windows reports a missing VCRUNTIME140.dll or MSVCP140.dll,
  install it from https://aka.ms/vs/17/release/vc_redist.x64.exe
- Your own game package (and optionally its Title Update), plus about 400 MB of
  free disk space next to the program for the game files


INSTALL
-------
1. Extract the ZIP anywhere you can write to (not "Program Files").
2. Run ssf2t_hd_remix.exe. The launcher opens.
3. On the Play page, click "Install Game".
4. Select your Super Street Fighter II Turbo HD Remix Xbox Live Arcade
   package. It is one file with a long hexadecimal name and no extension. On an
   Xbox 360 hard drive it is in Content\0000000000000000\584108A4\000D0000\
5. Wait while the launcher checks the package and copies the game files into
   the "game" folder next to the program.
6. Optional: click "Install Title Update" and select the Title Update #1 package. On an
   Xbox 360 hard drive it is in
   Content\0000000000000000\584108A4\000B0000\
   The two packages are installed separately, in either order. Installing one
   does not install the other, and each button refuses the other package. The
   launcher takes only the update's default.xexp from it.
7. When the Play page says "Ready to play", press PLAY. PLAY is enabled once
   the game package is installed.

To repair the game files, use "Reinstall Game" on the Play page. Your settings
and saves are kept, and so is an installed Title Update. "Remove Title Update"
deletes only default.xexp from the "game" folder and returns to game version
0.0.1.3; settings, saves and achievements are kept and the game stays ready to
play.


UPDATES
-------
The launcher checks the project's GitHub releases once per start. When a newer
release exists, an update banner appears in the header; nothing is installed
until you choose UPDATE NOW and then RESTART TO UPDATE. The update replaces
only the port's own program files. The "game" folder, "user_data", saves,
settings and logs are kept.


WINDOWS SMARTSCREEN
-------------------
The first time you run ssf2t_hd_remix.exe, Windows SmartScreen may show a
warning, because the program is not digitally signed. Choose "More info", then
"Run anyway".


PLAYING
-------
- Xbox controllers work without setup. The keyboard works too, as an Xbox 360
  controller; the Controls page lists the keys.
- F11 in the game switches between Windowed and Borderless Fullscreen. F11 in
  the launcher switches only the launcher.
- F7 opens the achievements list. The game's own Achievements menu item opens
  it too. Achievements are kept on this PC only; Ranked Match is not offered,
  so the four that need online ranked matches cannot be earned.
- F2 shows or hides a frame counter in the corner of the window.
- Saves work as on the console: the game saves to its own storage and loads it
  again at the next start. There is no Xbox Live connection.
- Online play: on the launcher's Online page turn Online play on, choose an
  Online name, run the Connection test, exchange Friend codes and accept the
  request, then press PLAY and choose Multiplayer > Online Match in the game
  (Find Match, Create Match or Invite Player). Matches use a direct UDP
  connection and fall back to a relay automatically. Both players must run the
  same game version (0.0.1.3 or 0.0.2.3). F3 shows the Ping display.
- To open the launcher again after turning it off, hold Shift while starting.

Launcher options:
- Display: Windowed or Borderless Fullscreen, window size, monitor, aspect
  ratio, VSync and Presentation (Letterbox keeps the picture's proportions,
  Stretch fills the window).
- Graphics: graphics card, render resolution, internal render resolution,
  anti-aliasing, multisampling and texture filtering.
- Gameplay: language (English, French, German, Italian, Spanish or Portugues Brasil), and what
  the window title and the corner counter show.
- Achievements: unlocked achievements and gamerscore.

The game always runs at its original speed of 60 updates per second.


WHERE THINGS ARE
----------------
- Game files:     the "game" folder next to ssf2t_hd_remix.exe
- Logs:           the "logs" folder next to ssf2t_hd_remix.exe
- Settings, saves, achievements and launcher settings:
                  the "user_data" folder next to ssf2t_hd_remix.exe
                  (created the first time it is needed)

Copy the whole program folder to another PC to take your saves, achievements
and settings with it. To update by hand, extract the new version over the old folder,
or move "user_data" (and "game") into the new one: deleting the old folder
deletes "user_data" with it.

If the game does not start or crashes, please attach the newest file from the
"logs" folder to a report at
https://github.com/saulob/ssf2t-hd-remix-recompiled/issues
The launcher and the game write to the same log for one session, and after a
crash the log ends with a CRASH REPORT section. For other problems,
turn on Detailed logging on the About page, reproduce the problem and attach
the newest log. "Open logs folder" on the same page opens the folder.


LICENSE
-------
The original project code of this port is licensed under the GNU General
Public License v2.0 only (GPL-2.0-only). The full text is in LICENSE.

Third-party components keep their own licenses. Their license files and
notices are in the "licenses" folder: ReXGlue-LICENSE.txt and
THIRD-PARTY-LICENSES.txt.

The launcher is TRG Launcher 1.1.0 (https://github.com/TekRantGaming/trg-launcher),
licensed under the MIT License (see licenses\THIRD-PARTY-LICENSES.txt).

Game files are not included and are not covered by this project's license.
This port is not affiliated with or endorsed by the makers or publishers of
Super Street Fighter II Turbo HD Remix.

# ReXGlue runtime settings, read from <exe dir>/ssf2t_hd_remix.toml.
# The launcher writes the player's choices to <user data>/settings.toml, which is loaded after this file.
# Full (purchased) license for XamContentGetLicenseMask; the SDK default 0 means trial.
license_mask = 1
gpu_plugin = "xenos"

# Keyboard emulates an Xbox 360 pad, with ReXGlue's default bindings.
mnk_mode = true
# The keyboard keeps player 1 and controllers start at player 2, so the keyboard and a pad can play Local Match together.
input_keyboard_own_user = true
# Empty skips the optional gamecontrollerdb.txt load; SDL's built-in mappings still apply.
hid_mappings_file = ""

# Default game window: 853x480 logical, centered on the primary display. Logical pixels are scaled by the display scale.
fullscreen = false
monitor = 1
window_width = 853
window_height = 480
# true letterboxes the picture to its aspect ratio; false stretches it to fill the window.
present_letterbox = true
# Guest video mode for 16:9 Original, assumed 720p until the first log confirms it.
video_mode_width = 1280
video_mode_height = 720

route.title: Attach already configured direct play
route.instruction: In the upstream Play page, finish all settings and set Show this launcher to Off. Then select ssf2t_hd_remix.exe, use the complete extracted player folder as working directory and leave arguments empty. Review the intent and request Play separately without holding Shift. With ready files the app selects the appropriate image and continues into the linked game in process. Installing/removing a TU or changing restart-required settings in an open launcher can relaunch the program; finish those operations before attachment. This guide uses no internal skip flag or tracking promise across a successor.

source_setup.title: Prepare the exact base and optional update upstream
source_setup.instruction: Use a complete player and components you are independently permitted to use, with your own purchased XBLA game, title 584108A4 / media 37B7D7D3. Base013 uses default.xex version 0.0.1.3, 3,932,160 bytes, CRC32 B734F075, SHA256 6E1C2F9ED7D1102A311A5F5626563527EDA5F85B2FBE8DB8405B866DED3F31EE. Optional official Title Update #1 is a separate 000B0000 package with default.xexp, 2,166,784 bytes, CRC32 38DE2310, SHA256 A2E8E66B482C5D3A0D3A5D3F67A3CECB7A12CE1F6189196694FD3E765910606C, selecting TU023 / 0.0.2.3. The game package is 000D0000. These identify known files, not entitlement or publisher authentication. Before first start or upgrade, keep independent copies of legacy saves/settings: upstream can migrate and remove the old data folder.

persistence.title: Preserve portable, legacy and explicit roots
persistence.instruction: Normally keep user_data/ beside the program, including settings.toml, saves, profiles, achievements and caches, plus game/, logs and original package/TU files. The selected source can copy/verify legacy runtime data into user_data and remove the old folder after success; failures can keep using the legacy root and retry later. An existing --user_data_root explicitly selects another root. Use the upstream folder/status display to identify the active layout, retain independent copies of both old/new roots before maintenance, and preserve external paths. This guide performs no migration, restore, backup or deletion.

limitations: Keep independent legacy and portable-data recovery copies before upstream migration. Complete base/TU selection and settings restarts upstream; the updater and online version matching have separate scope.
rows.closure_boundary: Finite source/setup and existing non-owning registration outcome; independent review and delivery required. No Supported/native/managed-operation acceptance.

rows.canonical_next_action: Review official player setup and data/persistence boundaries for the specific offered route; metadata alone does not qualify execution.

"Off keeps the original 16:9 picture, with black bars on wider or taller screens. On renders a wider picture on 21:9 and 32:9 screens (more view at the sides) or a taller one on 16:10, so it fills the screen. No change on 16:9 screens. Applies at the next start." = "Выкл. оставляет исходную картинку 16:9 с чёрными полосами на более широких или высоких экранах. Вкл. рисует более широкую картинку на экранах 21:9 и 32:9 (больше обзора по бокам) или более высокую на 16:10, чтобы заполнить экран. На экранах 16:9 ничего не меняется. Применяется после перезапуска."
"On waits for the display: no tearing, and G-SYNC/FreeSync displays still follow the frame rate. Off shows each frame at once: lowest latency, may tear; needed for Uncapped." = "Вкл. ждёт монитор: без разрывов, а мониторы с G-SYNC/FreeSync по-прежнему следуют частоте кадров. Выкл. показывает каждый кадр сразу: минимальная задержка, возможны разрывы; нужно для режима «Без ограничения»."
"On keeps the game at most two frames ahead of the display, so the picture answers the controls sooner: about a third less delay at 144 Hz with the same frame rate. At 60 FPS the game is never further ahead, so nothing changes there, and with VSync Off frames are shown at once, so it does nothing. Off lets more frames queue up." = "Вкл. держит игру не более чем на два кадра впереди монитора, поэтому картинка быстрее отвечает на управление: примерно на треть меньше задержки при 144 Гц с той же частотой кадров. При 60 FPS игра и так не уходит дальше вперёд, поэтому там ничего не меняется, а с выключенной VSync кадры показываются сразу, и настройка ни на что не влияет. Выкл. позволяет копить больше кадров в очереди."
"Frames that may wait for the display. 1 responds fastest; 2 evens out uneven frames." = "Сколько кадров может ждать монитор. 1 — самый быстрый отклик; 2 выравнивает неровные кадры."
"Game speed is the same at every frame rate. With VSync, a rate that divides your monitor's refresh moves evenly; other rates are even only on G-SYNC/FreeSync displays. 30 (Original) keeps the console's pacing." = "Скорость игры одинакова при любой частоте кадров. С VSync плавно идёт частота, на которую делится частота монитора; другие частоты плавны только на мониторах с G-SYNC/FreeSync. «30 (оригинал)» сохраняет темп консоли."
"Highest frame rate for the Custom setting (0 = no cap)." = "Наибольшая частота кадров для варианта «Своё ограничение» (0 = без ограничения)."
"Menus, the title screen and loading run at up to about 60 FPS (48 on a 144 Hz monitor). The menu backdrop costs more graphics work per frame than gameplay, so this saves power, heat and fan noise." = "Меню, заставка и загрузка идут примерно до 60 FPS (48 на мониторе 144 Гц). Фон меню требует от видеокарты больше работы на кадр, чем сама игра, поэтому так экономятся энергия, нагрев и шум вентиляторов."
"Renders the 3D scene at a multiple of the console's 1280 x 720, then fits it to your screen (2x on a 1080p screen is supersampling). Automatic times your graphics card on the title screen once, then picks the highest scale that keeps the busiest street at your recommended frame rate (60-120 FPS); until then it guesses from video memory. With Upscaling on Automatic, a scale below your screen uses AMD FSR 1. 3x costs about twice 2x on the graphics card (about 100 FPS on a current high-end card in the busiest street)." = "Рисует 3D-сцену в кратном консольному 1280 x 720 разрешении и затем подгоняет её под экран (2x на экране 1080p — это суперсэмплинг). «Автоматически» один раз замеряет видеокарту на заставке и выбирает наибольший масштаб, при котором самая нагруженная улица идёт с рекомендуемой частотой кадров (60-120 FPS); до замера масштаб оценивается по объёму видеопамяти. Если «Масштабирование» стоит на «Автоматически», масштаб ниже разрешения экрана использует AMD FSR 1. 3x нагружает видеокарту примерно вдвое сильнее, чем 2x (около 100 FPS на современной топовой видеокарте на самой нагруженной улице)."
"Smooths jagged edges after rendering. FXAA Extreme is smoother but softer; SMAA finds real edges and keeps textures and text sharper." = "Сглаживает зубчатые края после отрисовки. FXAA Extreme сглаживает сильнее, но мягче; SMAA находит настоящие края и сохраняет текстуры и текст более чёткими."
"How the rendered image is fitted to your screen. AMD FSR 1 upscales with sharp edges and runs on any graphics card; it also sharpens an image that already matches the screen. Automatic uses FSR 1 only when upscaling (for example 1x internal scale on a 1440p screen) and leaves a 1:1 image untouched. Off stretches with plain bilinear filtering." = "Как готовое изображение подгоняется под экран. AMD FSR 1 увеличивает с чёткими краями и работает на любой видеокарте; оно также повышает резкость изображения, которое уже совпадает с экраном. «Автоматически» использует FSR 1 только при увеличении (например, внутренний масштаб 1x на экране 1440p) и не трогает изображение 1:1. «Выкл.» растягивает обычной билинейной фильтрацией."
"Keeps textures sharp at glancing angles. 16x is recommended." = "Сохраняет чёткость текстур под острыми углами. Рекомендуется 16x."
"The game's own edge smoothing of the 3D scene. The console dropped from 4x to 2x when it ran short of graphics time; on PC that switch also reacts to loading hitches and slow menus (37.5 FPS on a 75 Hz screen) and can stay on 2x. Always 4x keeps the console's quality and, above internal scale 1x, is also the faster mode on PC. Always 2x is faster only at 1x. Automatic is the game's own switch." = "Собственное сглаживание краёв 3D-сцены. Консоль переходила с 4x на 2x, когда не хватало времени видеочипа; на ПК это переключение реагирует ещё и на подвисания при загрузке и медленные меню (37,5 FPS на экране 75 Гц) и может застрять на 2x. «Всегда 4x» сохраняет консольное качество и при внутреннем масштабе выше 1x на ПК ещё и быстрее. «Всегда 2x» быстрее только при 1x. «Автоматически» — собственное переключение игры."
"Above internal scale 1x, keeps the glow around lights and in bright flashes as smooth as on the console. Off draws the glow as in 0.9.0, with a little banding in bright flashes; use it if the glow looks wrong on your graphics card." = "При внутреннем масштабе выше 1x свечение вокруг источников света и в ярких вспышках остаётся таким же плавным, как на консоли. «Выкл.» рисует свечение как в 0.9.0, с лёгкими полосами в ярких вспышках; включите этот вариант, если свечение на вашей видеокарте выглядит неправильно."
"The game's camera motion blur." = "Размытие камеры в движении, как в игре."
"Removes shimmering and jagged edges by combining several frames, at the internal scale (no upscaling). TAA is built in and works on any graphics card. NVIDIA DLAA uses NVIDIA's AI model on GeForce RTX cards. AMD FSR 3.1 and Intel XeSS run on most modern cards. If the chosen one can't start, TAA is used. Best with Anti-aliasing set to Off. Applies at the next start." = "Убирает мерцание и зубчатые края, объединяя несколько кадров, во внутреннем масштабе (без увеличения). TAA встроено и работает на любой видеокарте. NVIDIA DLAA использует ИИ-модель NVIDIA на видеокартах GeForce RTX. AMD FSR 3.1 и Intel XeSS работают на большинстве современных видеокарт. Если выбранный вариант не запускается, используется TAA. Лучше всего со «Сглаживанием» в положении «Выкл.». Применяется после перезапуска."
"Shows an installed HD texture pack instead of the game's own textures. Packs are made by players and don't come with the game. The whole pack loads in the background from the start (540 MB took under 2 seconds from an NVMe SSD; each original shows until its replacement is ready) and then stays in video memory. Off loads nothing: the game looks and runs as before." = "Показывает установленный HD-пакет текстур вместо собственных текстур игры. Пакеты делают игроки, с игрой они не поставляются. Весь пакет загружается в фоне с самого начала (540 МБ — меньше 2 секунд с NVMe SSD; пока замена не готова, показывается оригинал) и остаётся в видеопамяти. «Выкл.» ничего не загружает: игра выглядит и работает как прежде."
"Shows \"Achievement unlocked\" with its name at the bottom right of the game when you earn one. Your unlocks are kept either way (in the saves folder, content\\achievements)." = "Показывает в правом нижнем углу игры «Achievement unlocked» и название, когда вы получаете достижение. Полученные достижения сохраняются в любом случае (в папке сохранений, content\\achievements)."
"How wide the view is, in horizontal degrees on a 16:9 screen (wider screens see more at the sides). The original is 86. Zooming keeps its magnification." = "Ширина обзора в градусах по горизонтали на экране 16:9 (на более широких экранах видно больше по бокам). В оригинале 86. Приближение сохраняет своё увеличение."
"Play with keyboard and mouse. A connected controller keeps working." = "Игра с клавиатурой и мышью. Подключённый геймпад продолжает работать."
"Native turns the camera directly with the mouse (recommended). Right-stick bridge sends the mouse through the controller stick, with its dead zone and ramp." = "«Прямой» поворачивает камеру мышью напрямую (рекомендуется). «Через правый стик» передаёт движение мыши через стик геймпада, с его мёртвой зоной и разгоном."
"Mouse turning speed. 1.0 turns 0.066 degrees per mouse count." = "Скорость поворота мышью. 1.0 — поворот на 0,066 градуса за отсчёт мыши."
"Moving the mouse forward looks down." = "Движение мыши вперёд наклоняет взгляд вниз."
"Extra speed for fast flicks through the right-stick bridge." = "Дополнительная скорость для резких движений в режиме «Через правый стик»."
"Blends each mouse step with the previous one in the right-stick bridge." = "Смешивает каждый шаг мыши с предыдущим в режиме «Через правый стик»."
"Which controller slot the keyboard and mouse play as." = "Каким слотом геймпада считаются клавиатура и мышь."
"The game's own controller look sensitivity." = "Собственная чувствительность обзора геймпадом в игре."
"Pushing the right stick forward looks down." = "Наклон правого стика вперёд опускает взгляд вниз."
"Controller rumble strength." = "Сила вибрации геймпада."
"Opens these settings during play (Esc also closes them)." = "Открывает эти настройки во время игры (Esc тоже закрывает их)."
"The buttons the game's prompts show. Automatic shows the keys you bound while you play with keyboard and mouse, and Xbox buttons again as soon as you use a controller." = "Какие кнопки показывают подсказки игры. «Автоматически» показывает назначенные клавиши, пока вы играете клавиатурой и мышью, и снова кнопки Xbox, как только вы берёте геймпад."
"Overall game volume." = "Общая громкость игры."
"Language of the game's text and speech. Automatic follows the Windows display language, like the console's dashboard language (English when the game has no such language)." = "Язык текста и речи игры. «Автоматически» следует языку интерфейса Windows, как язык панели консоли (английский, если в игре нет такого языка). Русского языка в этой версии игры нет; язык лаунчера выбирается вверху справа."
"The game's prompts show Xbox buttons; these are the keys and mouse buttons that press them, each named with its action in the game's default controller layout. Click a binding, then press a key or mouse button (F1-F12 are reserved)." = "Подсказки игры показывают кнопки Xbox; здесь — клавиши и кнопки мыши, которые их нажимают, с действием из стандартной раскладки геймпада. Щёлкните назначение, затем нажмите клавишу или кнопку мыши (F1-F12 зарезервированы)."
"The Xbox Guide button; the game does not use it." = "Кнопка Xbox Guide; игра её не использует."
"Temporal upscaler" = "Временное масштабирование"
"Upscaler detail" = "Детализация масштабирования"
"NVIDIA DLSS" = "NVIDIA DLSS"
"AMD FSR 3.1" = "AMD FSR 3.1"
"Intel XeSS" = "Intel XeSS"
"Native AA (DLAA)" = "Только сглаживание (DLAA)"
"Quality (1.5x)" = "Качество (1,5x)"
"Balanced (1.7x)" = "Баланс (1,7x)"
"Performance (2x)" = "Производительность (2x)"
"Ultra Performance (3x)" = "Ультрапроизводительность (3x)"
" - not installed, off" = " — не установлено, выкл."
"Draws the game at the internal scale and lets the chosen upscaler build a larger, sharper image from several frames, so a low internal scale looks close to a higher one for much less graphics time. NVIDIA DLSS needs a GeForce RTX card; AMD FSR 3.1 and Intel XeSS run on most modern cards. The HUD and subtitles are kept from the game's own frame. If the upscaler can't start, the game runs as with Off. Applies at the next start." = "Игра рисуется во внутреннем масштабе, а выбранный апскейлер строит из нескольких кадров изображение крупнее и чётче: низкий внутренний масштаб выглядит почти как более высокий при гораздо меньшей нагрузке на видеокарту. NVIDIA DLSS требует видеокарту GeForce RTX; AMD FSR 3.1 и Intel XeSS работают на большинстве современных видеокарт. Интерфейс и субтитры берутся из собственного кадра игры. Если апскейлер не запускается, игра работает как с «Выкл.». Применяется после перезапуска."
"How much larger the upscaled image is than the internal scale: Quality 1.5x, Balanced 1.7x, Performance 2x, Ultra Performance 3x (internal scale 1x with Performance gives a 1440p image for about the cost of 1x). or later (LGPL v2.1+). Read the file `COPYING.LGPLv2.1` for details. Some other
files have MIT/X11/BSD-style licenses. In combination the LGPL v2.1+ applies to
FFmpeg.

Some optional parts of FFmpeg are licensed under the GNU General Public License
version 2 or later (GPL v2+). See the file `COPYING.GPLv2` for details. None of
these parts are used by default, you have to explicitly pass `--enable-gpl` to
configure to activate them. In this case, FFmpeg's license changes to GPL v2+.

Specifically, the GPL parts of FFmpeg are:

- libpostproc
- optional x86 optimization in the files
    - `libavcodec/x86/flac_dsp_gpl.asm`
    - `libavcodec/x86/idct_mmx.c`
    - `libavfilter/x86/vf_removegrain.asm`
- the following building and testing tools
    - `compat/solaris/make_sunver.pl`

    - `doc/texi2pod.pl`
    - `libswresample/tests/swresample.c`
    - `tests/checkasm/*`

- the following filters in libavfilter:
    - `signature_lookup.c`
    - `vf_blackframe.c`
    - `vf_boxblur.c`
    - `vf_colormatrix.c`
    - `vf_cover_rect.c`
    - `vf_cropdetect.c`

    - `vf_mcdeint.c`
    - `vf_mpdecimate.c`
    - `vf_nnedi.c`
    - `vf_owdenoise.c`
    - `vf_perspective.c`
    - `vf_phase.c`
    - `vf_pp.c`
    - `vf_pp7.c`
    - `vf_pullup.c`
    - `vf_repeatfields.c`
    - `vf_sab.c`
    - `vf_signature.c`
    - `vf_smartblur.c`
    - `vf_spp.c`
    - `vf_stereo3d.c`
    - `vf_super2xsai.c`
    - `vf_tinterlace.c`
    - `vf_uspp.c`
    - `vf_vaguedenoiser.c`
    - `vsrc_mptestsrc.c`

Should you, for whatever reason, prefer to use version 3 of the (L)GPL, then
the configure parameter `--enable-version3` will activate this licensing option
for you. Read the file `COPYING.LGPLv3` or, if you have enabled GPL parts,

There are a handful of files under other licensing terms, namely:

* The files `libavcodec/jfdctfst.c`, `libavcodec/jfdctint_template.c` and
  `libavcodec/jrevdct.c` are taken from libjpeg, see the top of the files for
  licensing details. Specifically note that you must credit the IJG in the
  documentation accompanying your program if you only distribute executables.
  You must also indicate any changes including additions and deletions to
  those three files in the documentation.
* `tests/reference.pnm` is under the expat license.


## External libraries

FFmpeg can be combined with a number of external libraries, which sometimes
affect the licensing of binaries resulting from the combination.

### Compatible libraries

The following libraries are under GPL version 2:
- avisynth
- frei0r
- libcdio
- libdavs2
- librubberband
- libvidstab
- libx264
- libx265
- libxavs
- libxavs2
- libxvid

When combining them with FFmpeg, FFmpeg needs to be licensed as GPL as well by
passing `--enable-gpl` to configure.

The following libraries are under LGPL version 3:
- gmp
- libaribb24
- liblensfun

When combining them with FFmpeg, use the configure option `--enable-version3` to
upgrade FFmpeg to the LGPL v3.

The VMAF, mbedTLS, RK MPI, OpenCORE and VisualOn libraries are under the Apache License
2.0. That license is incompatible with the LGPL v2.1 and the GPL v2, but not with
version 3 of those licenses. So to combine these libraries with FFmpeg, the
license version needs to be upgraded by passing `--enable-version3` to configure.

The smbclient library is under the GPL v3, to combine it with FFmpeg,
the options `--enable-gpl` and `--enable-version3` have to be passed to
configure to upgrade FFmpeg to the GPL v3.

### Incompatible libraries

There are certain libraries you can combine with FFmpeg whose licenses are not
compatible with the GPL and/or the LGPL. If you wish to enable these
libraries, even in circumstances that their license may be incompatible, pass
`--enable-nonfree` to configure. This will cause the resulting binary to be
unredistributable.

The Fraunhofer FDK AAC and OpenSSL libraries are under licenses which are
incompatible with the GPLv2 and v3. To the best of our knowledge, they are
compatible with the LGPL.

packaged_documentation.presets/balanced_1080p.toml:
# 1080p balanced-quality preset
# Presents the verified 1280x720 guest viewport at 1920x1080. Internal scaling
# is disabled because deterministic title probes proved scale 2 corrupts
# screen-space composition; this preset makes no native-1080p-render claim.
pc_config_version = 1
output_resolution = "1080p"
window_width = 0
window_height = 0
fullscreen = true
window_mode = "borderless"
monitor = 0

resolution_scale = 1
swap_post_effect = "none"
anisotropic_override = 5

[general]
language = "english"
achievement_notifications = true

[graphics]
motion_blur = true
motion_blur_off_shader_pack = ""
hd_textures = false
temporal_aa = "off"
upscaler = "off"
upscale_mode = "quality"
msaa_mode = "4x"
glow_reconstruction = "on"

[present]
effect = "bilinear"
letterbox = true
allow_overscan_cutoff = false
safe_area_x = 100
safe_area_y = 100

[display]
present_mode = "vsync"
max_frame_latency = 2
low_latency = "on"
frame_limit = 0
frame_rate = "original"
menu_frame_rate = "reduced"
widescreen = false

[camera]
field_of_view = 86.0

[audio]
master_volume = 1.0

[input]
keyboard_mouse = false
keyboard_mouse_user_index = 0
mouse_sensitivity = 1.0
mouse_acceleration = 0.0
mouse_smoothing = 0.0
mouse_invert_y = false
button_prompts = "auto"
mouse_look = "native"
overlay_key = "F1"
controller_sensitivity = "medium"
controller_invert_y = false
vibration_scale = 1.0

[diagnostics]
camera_state = false

[streamline]
frame_generation = 0

[cheats]
god_mode = false
give_all = false

packaged_documentation.README.md:
# Estacado: a native PC recompilation of The Darkness (Xbox 360)

An unofficial fan port of *The Darkness* (Xbox 360, 2007), made by static
recompilation: the game's PowerPC code is translated into C++ and runs
natively on Windows, with a Direct3D 12 graphics layer built on
[ReXGlue](https://github.com/rexglue/rexglue-sdk) and
[XenonRecomp](https://github.com/hedge-dev/XenonRecomp).

This is a free, non-commercial fan project. **No game data is included:** you
need your own copy of the game (see [Game files](#game-files) and
[Legal](#legal)).

> **Pre-release.** So far it has been tested on one Windows 11 PC with an
> NVIDIA RTX graphics card. Other hardware (AMD, Intel, older NVIDIA, laptops)
> is untested. Please report what you find.

**Steam Deck:** a player reports that with 0.9.1 both the settings launcher
and the game work on the Deck under Proton: the launcher starts there and
launches into the game ([issue #2](https://github.com/invinceble55-wq/Estacado/issues/2)).
A Steam Deck preset is included. If you copy the folder to a Deck, see
[Saves and settings](#saves-and-settings) to take your saves along.

## What it offers

- **Frame rates beyond 30**: 60, your display's refresh rate (120/144/240),
  a custom limit or uncapped, with the game's timing kept correct (scripted
  scenes, physics and audio run at their original speed).
- **Resolution**: the 3D scene at 1x, 2x or 3x the console's 1280 x 720, or
  automatic (the launcher measures your graphics card once), fitted to any
  output resolution; windowed, borderless or automatic.
- **Anti-aliasing**: SMAA (default) or FXAA; AMD FSR 1 or CAS sharpening when
  the image is fitted to your screen. The game's own 4x MSAA stays on all the
  time by default (the console dropped to 2x when it ran slowly).
- **Widescreen (experimental)**: fills 21:9, 32:9 and 16:10 screens with more
  view at the sides; menus stay centred.
- **Controls**: keyboard and mouse with native mouse look and rebindable
  keys (on-screen prompts show your keys), or a controller; adjustable field
  of view.
- **Settings** in a launcher (presets: Enhanced, Performance, Original, Steam
  Deck) and in an overlay over the running game (F1), in English or Russian.
- **Achievements** with an in-game notification, saved where achievement
  trackers find them; the launcher tells you when a new version is out.
- **Motion blur on/off** and support for **HD texture packs**: folder-based
  replacements made by players. No pack is included or provided (the game's
  textures belong to its publisher); [docs/HD_TEXTURE_PACKS.md](docs/HD_TEXTURE_PACKS.md)
  explains how to install one and how to make one.

## Requirements

- Windows 10 or 11, 64-bit.
- A CPU with AVX2 (Intel Haswell / AMD Zen or newer).
- A Direct3D 12 graphics card with current drivers.
- [Microsoft Visual C++ 2015-2022 Redistributable (x64)](https://aka.ms/vs/17/release/vc_redist.x64.exe).
- About 8 GB of free disk space if you use a disc image (it is extracted
  once).

## Game files

The recompiled code is that of this version, the one we own and test:

| | |
|---|---|
| Game | *The Darkness*, Xbox 360, USA/Europe disc (En, Fr, De, Es, It), title ID 545407EE |
| Disc image (Redump) | `Darkness, The (USA, Europe) (En,Fr,De,Es,It).iso`, SHA-256 `46f7305c1e1972e888d3624f15b0ed483923aeeb50ecad0c6bf5b42f69d52a90` |
| `default.xex` | SHA-256 `aace35a8f9bcdc7f28aeab9ff8cf3bdf200353f5c83705f6284487347acb3c5f` |

**Other releases** are accepted when they contain the same code. The launcher
decides this itself: it decrypts your `default.xex` and compares its code,
its structure and the data the code depends on with the version above. Text,
fonts and the game's own strings may differ, so a localised release that only
replaces those works and shows its own language. We can only fully test the
version we own: we checked a Russian release this way (same code, only text
and font data differ) but have not played it through.

A release with different code (another build of the game, or a title update)
does not run yet. The launcher says so plainly and saves a detailed report,
`game_version_report.txt` in the `logs` folder (names, sizes and hashes only,
no game data), that you can attach to an issue if you like. Never upload game
files.

Dump the game from your own disc; this project does not provide or link to
game files.

## Install

Extract the zip to a folder of your choice (not inside *Program Files*).

### First start

1. Run `TheDarknessSettings.exe` (the launcher).
2. On the first start it asks for your game: **Choose disc image...** (your
   `.iso`) or **Choose game folder...** (a folder with the extracted files, the
   one that contains `default.xex`). It checks that the version is supported;
   a disc image is extracted into the `game` folder next to the launcher.
3. Pick a preset (Enhanced is recommended), adjust anything you like and press
   **Play**.

The launcher's **About** button shows the version and where your saves are,
and opens the licence texts and the `logs` folder.

### Saves and settings

Your saves and settings are kept in your Saved Games folder,
`%USERPROFILE%\Saved Games\Estacado` (settings: `TheDarkness.pc.toml`; saves:
`content`), apart from the program. An update can go into a new folder or
over the old one without touching your progress.

- **Coming from 0.9.0:** extract the new version over your old folder (or
  into it). On its first start it copies that folder's saves, settings and
  screenshots to Saved Games, checks every copied file, and leaves the
  originals untouched as a backup (a note, `SAVES_MOVED.txt`, says so). If
  the copy cannot be made, the game keeps using the old folder and tries again
  at the next start.
- **0.9.0 in another folder:** in the launcher, **About**, then **Import
  saves...**, and choose the old folder. Saves already in Saved Games are kept
  under a new name, never overwritten.
- **Portable (USB drive, a folder copied to a Steam Deck or another PC):** put
  an empty file named `portable.txt` next to `TheDarkness.exe`. Saves and
  settings then stay inside the game folder (`TheDarkness.pc.toml` and
  `runtime_data`), as in 0.9.0.

## Settings overview

Open the launcher, or press **F1** in the game. Changes to resolution,
widescreen, language and a few graphics options apply at the next start; the
launcher says so for each.

- **Performance / Frame Rate**: *Frame rate* (Original 30, 60, display
  refresh, custom, uncapped), *VSync* (VSync, VRR/G-SYNC/FreeSync,
  immediate), *Menu frame rate*.
- **Display**: output resolution, window mode, monitor, *Fill wide and tall
  screens* (widescreen, experimental).
- **Graphics Quality**: resolution scale, anti-aliasing, upscaling, motion
  blur, HD texture packs.
- **Camera**: field of view.
- **Controls / Key bindings**: keyboard and mouse, mouse look, sensitivity,
  button prompts (automatic, Xbox buttons or keyboard keys), controller
  options.
- **Audio**: master volume.
- **Achievements**: the in-game notification.
- **Language**.

## Languages

English, French, German, Italian and Spanish: the game's own languages, for
its text and speech. Set *Language* in the launcher; *Automatic* follows the
Windows display language.

The launcher and the F1 settings are in English or Russian (they follow the
Windows display language; the picker beside *About* chooses by hand). Each
interface language is one file in the `languages` folder
(`languages/ru.toml`: English text = translation), so corrections and new
languages need no programming: edit or add a file and open an issue or a pull
request with it.

## Known issues

- Tested on one PC only (see the note at the top).
- Played on PC so far: every menu and the campaign from the start up to the
  orphanage explosion scene, including the Chinatown street and its combat.
  The chapters after that have not been played through yet. A check of
  everything the game can ask of the port found no gap on the single-player
  path (details in [docs/WHOLE_GAME_AUDIT.md](docs/WHOLE_GAME_AUDIT.md)); if
  the game stops anyway, it shows a message and saves a crash report: please
  send it.
- Multiplayer: the menus work, but there is no online or local network play.
  The port behaves like a console without a network connection: the Xbox
  LIVE modes and leaderboards ask for an Xbox LIVE sign-in and stay on the
  menu, and System Link finds no games.
- Widescreen (experimental): at 21:9 and wider, subtitles are drawn larger
  than at 16:9 and two-line subtitles can overlap.
- Shaders the release's list does not cover yet (mostly later levels) are
  compiled for your graphics card the first time they appear, which can
  stutter briefly; later sessions reuse them.
- Black flickering on some cards
  ([#20](https://github.com/invinceble55-wq/Estacado/issues/20)): probably
  the same cause as the black dots and flickering squares of
  [#16](https://github.com/invinceble55-wq/Estacado/issues/16), fixed in
  0.9.6; confirmation pending. If the glow looks wrong on your graphics
  card, *Graphics Quality > Glow reconstruction > Off* draws it as in 0.9.0.
- Being looked into: green glitches in the Otherworld until a restart
  ([#14](https://github.com/invinceble55-wq/Estacado/issues/14)) and face
  shading that flickers in some conversations
  ([#4](https://github.com/invinceble55-wq/Estacado/issues/4)).
- Not in this release: HDR output, temporal anti-aliasing with upscalers
  (such as DLSS, FSR 3 or XeSS) and frame generation. If you would use one of
  them, say so in an issue.

## Reporting a problem

Please open an issue with the **Bug report** template. It asks for:

- your CPU, graphics card, driver version, Windows version and screen
  resolution/refresh rate;
- your `TheDarkness.pc.toml` (settings, in `Saved Games\Estacado`) and what
  you did when the problem happened;
- the `logs` folder (launcher: **About**, then **Logs**; usually
  `%LOCALAPPDATA%\Estacado\logs`, or next to `TheDarkness.exe` in a portable
  copy): `runtime_crash.log` and any `TheDarkness_fatal_*.dmp` and
  `TheDarkness_stall_*.dmp` files.

For a visual glitch, press **F9** while it is on screen: the game saves a
screenshot and a small text file describing that frame in
`Saved Games\Estacado\screenshots`; attach both. For input or other
problems without a crash, create an empty file named `session_log.txt` next
to `TheDarkness.exe`, play until the problem happens, and attach the
`session_*.log` it writes in the `logs` folder.

Never attach game files (disc images, extracted files) to an issue.

## Building from source

See [BUILDING.md](BUILDING.md). In short: one script checks your game files,
recompiles your own `default.xex`, builds the runtime and packages it.
